lq.ANSWER:
Q1 — Method via harmony at four levels

  DEFINITE — single expected answer 

Model answer:  The basic human aspiration is continuous happiness and prosperity, and happiness is to be in harmony. Continuity of happiness is harmony at all four levels of being: as an individual human being, a member of a family, a member of society, and a unit in nature/existence. The method, therefore, is to ensure harmony at each level — harmony in the human being, the family, the society, and nature/existence. This is achieved by living with human consciousness, in which right understanding in the self comes first, fulfilment in relationship second, and physical facility third, leading to mutual happiness and mutual prosperity.

Q2 — Our Program

  DEFINITE — single expected answer 

Model answer:  Our program has two parts. The first is to facilitate the understanding of harmony at all levels of being — in the human being, the family, the society, and nature/existence — and then to live in harmony at all these levels. The second is the manner of working with proposals: whatever is presented is a proposal, to be (a) verified on the basis of our natural acceptance and (b) validated experientially by living accordingly. Through this we develop right understanding and right feeling. So the program is, on one hand, understanding and living in harmony at the four levels, and on the other, self-verification of proposals by natural acceptance together with experiential validation.

Q3 — Harmony at one level supports the others

  DEFINITE — single expected answer 

Model answer:  As things appear today, managing things at one level can seem to make another level difficult — for example, caring for a baby and doing justice to a job, or family members feeling upset when one invests time in right understanding. But the program is not about managing things; it is about ensuring harmony. If I try to understand and live in harmony at one level, it will help — or at least not contradict — harmony at the other levels. For instance, working for harmony at the individual level means ensuring right understanding and right feeling in the self; this facilitates harmony at the family level, because I can then ensure mutual fulfilment in my behaviour with right feelings, and similarly I can better participate in harmony at the level of society and nature.
